_comment: REQ-0152 inspection-kit registry. SINGLE SOURCE of kit identity/routing/version, read by BOTH the Node queue (server/services/art_jobs.cjs -> kits_for(kind), current kit_version for staleness) AND the Python runner (tools/inspect_job.py stamps kit_version onto every output). Bump kit_version on any threshold or algorithm change (drives the UI stale badge). blocking is true ONLY for bpskin.frame_gate, and it is enforced ONLY inside the generation recipe (compose consumes PASS frames); as an inspection here every kit is advisory and never gates adoption.
